analyst_view.overall: Early view: Cádiz (20th, 10 pts) have a new coach in Borja Jiménez, but lost at Mallorca and at home to Oviedo in his last two games and have taken only 8 of 24 points at the Nuevo Mirandilla. Sabadell (13th) have the second-tightest goal record in the division (12 scored, 11 conceded) and play a patient, crossing game. This looks like a cagey game between two sides that do not score many.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.9 goals. Sabadell's games have produced 23 goals in 13 and Cádiz have sat deep and countered under Jiménez, so a low total fits and I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners. Sabadell build through the wings and cross a lot, and Cádiz defended deep after scoring at Mallorca, so I lean slightly higher on corners.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.2 cards. Cádiz are in the relegation places and under pressure at home, which can raise the temperature, but no referee is known yet, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.7 shots. Sabadell have had territory but struggle to create clear chances, and Cádiz have been passive at home, so I lean a little lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 6.7 shots on target. Neither side has much cutting edge, which matches the low figure, so I stay with it.
